description: Move this session to ANOTHER workspace of the same person, with no sign-out and no key to paste. Call it with no `tenant` to list them (the current one is marked), with `tenant` to switch; the workspace's key goes to this server, never into the chat. Afterwards say which workspace you are on before changing anything. PERSONAL SIGN-IN (the user approved this connection in the A-Team app): works in every environment; a switch into a PROD workspace needs the user's yes first (confirm_prod). The production connector can also reach the user's DEV workspaces when its SysAdmin turned that on: the list shows both, each with its environment; the first time, pass environment "dev" and the answer asks the user to approve once on DEV (a link they open), then call again. With a workspace KEY instead, it is refused, with the reason, outside the dev environment, when the key was not minted by a signed-in person, when its workspace has more than one owner/admin, or when the person is not owner/admin of the target; calls then run as the person who minted that workspace's key.

confirm_prod.description: Personal sign-in only: true once the user said yes to working in this PROD workspace. Never set it without asking them first.

environment.description: Personal sign-in only: which environment the workspace is in, when the same name exists in both (or to list only one). Leave it out otherwise.

tenant.description: The workspace to switch to. Leave it out to list the workspaces you can switch to.

name: ateam_switch_workspace
